title: When Does Training on Synthetic Data Provably Work?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-quality training data are a major bottleneck in machine learning, motivating increasing use of artificially generated data. We study when a binary classifier trained on synthetic data transfers successfully to a real distribution, under a shared conditional label distribution. First, we derive finite-sample excess-error bounds when the real covariate distribution is absolutely continuous with respect to the synthetic distribution under a controlled density ratio. Second, we study the partially and fully singular case, where the real distribution has mass outside the synthetic one. If the hypothesis class is sufficiently expressive, synthetic risk alone cannot uniformly control real-world error: a classifier can be nearly optimal on synthetic data while approaching worst-case error on the uncovered real region, even when the distributions are arbitrarily close in Wasserstein distance. translated_title: 合成数据训练何时才能被证明有效？
translated_abstract: 高质量训练数据是机器学习中的一大瓶颈，这促使人们越来越多地使用人工生成的数据。我们研究了在共享条件标签分布的前提下，在合成数据上训练的二元分类器何时能够成功迁移到真实分布上。首先，当真实协变量分布在受控的密度比条件下关于合成分布绝对连续时，我们推导了有限样本超额误差界。其次，我们研究了部分奇异与完全奇异的情形，即真实分布在合成分布支撑之外存在概率质量。如果假设类具有足够的表达能力，那么仅凭合成风险无法一致地控制真实世界的误差：即使两个分布在 Wasserstein 距离上可以任意接近，一个分类器也可以在合成数据上几乎达到最优，同时在未被覆盖的真实区域上接近最坏情况的误差。对于假设函数与其对数…（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文从理论上刻画了合成数据训练何时可证明有效：在密度比受控时给出有限样本超额误差界，但若真实分布在合成分布支撑之外且假设类足够有表达能力，则仅凭合成风险无法保证真实世界的误差。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically characterizes when training on synthetic data provably transfers to real distributions, providing finite-sample excess-error bounds under controlled density ratios, and proving that when the real distribution has mass outside the synthetic support and the hypothesis class is sufficiently expressive, synthetic risk alone cannot control real-world error.
